FROM python:3.12.3-slim
WORKDIR /workspace
RUN python -m pip install --no-cache-dir pytest==9.0.3
COPY . /workspace
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* && python -m pip install --no-cache-dir -e '.[test]' 'pytest==9.0.3'
